tweets.text:
gm friends,

quick take: @rainbowdotme is slowly making dapp frontends optional.

not by killing them but by absorbing the parts users actually need, right into the wallet flow.

claimables? surfaced automatically.
swaps? native.
bridging? native.
perps? native.
DeFi positions? displayed cleanly.
routing? handled behind the scenes.

at some point you realize you’re doing 70–80% of your onchain actions without ever opening a dapp UI.

and imo that’s where the ecosystem is heading:
the wallet becomes the first interface,
dapps become backends,
and the user stops juggling tabs entirely.

it’s not loud, but it’s happening, one feature at a time.
